description: This is a Perl script for flashing firmware onto an ADSL2MUE device, including network device discovery and FTP-based file transfer.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP that provides upper case command methods and additional environment variable retrieval functions.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends the USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends a reboot command to the FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device via FTP.
